key_insight: The right amount of agent memory depends on the model: strong models can benefit from full guideline sets, while weaker models may perform better with selected subsets.
engineering_relevance: Tune memory selection per model and validate it end to end rather than assuming more remembered guidance improves reliability.
method: Mine 1–3 short lessons from each agent trajectory.
Consolidate lessons into guidelines, recording how many lessons each merges.
Provide all guidelines or a selected subset at inference.
evidence_signal: On AppWorld, DeepSeek-V3.2 gained 9.5 percentage points in task completion with all 191 guidelines; gpt-oss-120b rose from 39.9% to 51.2% with all 199, versus 55.4% with about 29 selected guidelines (mean of two runs).
watch_item: Frequently supported guidelines can backfire, and lost provenance or swallowed API errors can undermine memory reliability and evaluation.
paper_title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
